title: A real conversation in easy English about hair 💇‍♀️💈: Real Easy English

sentences.en: Hello, I'm Georgie.
And I'm Phil.
Welcome to Real Easy English.
sentences.ko: Real Easy English에 오신 걸 환영해요.

sentences.en: Find all the vocabulary and a worksheet to test what you've learned over on our website.
sentences.ko: 모든 어휘와 배운 걸 확인할 학습지는 웹사이트에서 볼 수 있어요.

sentences.en: Go to bbclearningenglish.com.
Hi Phil. How are you doing?
I'm doing really well, Georgie.
I must say, your hair is looking fantastic today.
Thank you very much, Phil.
Today we are talking about hair.
Now, I can see your hair, but for our listeners maybe you can start by describing your hair.
sentences.ko: 제 눈엔 당신 머리가 보이지만, 청취자분들을 위해 먼저 당신 머리를 묘사해 줄래요?

sentences.en: OK. Well, my hair – it's short, but it's not very short.
sentences.ko: 좋아요. 음, 제 머리는 짧은데, 아주 짧진 않아요.

sentences.en: I think it's fairly straight.
And then the colour – it's kind of a light brown colour.
The bits that aren't grey, that is!
You said your hair used to be ginger.
Yes, it used to be ginger – bright orange.
Wow! Well, my hair is naturally dark brown.
sentences.ko: 와! 음, 제 머리는 원래 짙은 갈색이에요.

sentences.en: It's quite short and it's wavy, so sometimes it can be curly, but mostly it's wavy.
sentences.ko: 꽤 짧고 웨이브가 있어서, 가끔 곱슬일 때도 있지만 대부분은 물결 모양이에요.

sentences.en: OK. So, you've told us about your hair, Georgie.
sentences.ko: 좋아요. 조지, 머리에 대해 말해 줬는데요.

sentences.en: Do you like it?
Yes, I do now.
I actually... When I was younger, I didn't really like my hair because I wanted it to be straight, so I used to straighten it – take the curls and the waves out.
sentences.ko: 사실... 어렸을 땐 생머리를 원해서 제 머리가 별로였어요. 그래서 곱슬과 웨이브를 펴려고 스트레이트를 하곤 했어요.

sentences.en: But as I've got older, I've started to really like my hair.
sentences.ko: 그런데 나이가 들면서 제 머리가 정말 좋아지기 시작했어요.

sentences.en: It looks a bit wild and I enjoy it.
What about you? How do you...
Do you like your hair?
Yeah, usually I do.
I think similar to you.
When I was a teenager, I just wanted my hair to look different, so I used to try and stick hair gel in it and try and make it do things that it didn't want to do and it wasn't going to do.
sentences.ko: 십 대 땐 그냥 머리가 다르게 보였으면 해서, 헤어젤을 바르고 머리가 하기 싫어하는, 절대 안 될 모양을 만들려고 애썼어요.

sentences.en: And I used to get very frustrated about that.
And then as you get older and wiser, you realise actually it looks fine.
sentences.ko: 그런데 나이 들고 현명해지면서, 사실 괜찮아 보인다는 걸 깨닫게 돼요.

sentences.en: And I quite... I quite like it.
I don't get my hair cut that often, so it often gets a bit too long and messy for me.
sentences.ko: 저는 머리를 자주 안 잘라서, 종종 너무 길고 지저분해져요.

sentences.en: And then when I can't put up with it any longer, I go and get it cut.
sentences.ko: 그러다 더는 못 참겠으면 가서 잘라요.

sentences.en: And how do you feel about the hairdresser?
Do you like the experience?
I don't mind it.
It's not...
it's not something I really like doing but I don't really mind it.
sentences.ko: 정말 좋아하는 건 아니지만 별로 싫지도 않아요.

sentences.en: I don't have a problem with it and it does feel good to come out and it's a lot neater than it was when you went in.
sentences.ko: 문제 될 건 없고, 들어갈 때보다 훨씬 깔끔해져서 나오면 기분이 좋아요.

sentences.en: Yeah. How long does a usual appointment take when you go to the hairdresser?
sentences.ko: 네. 미용실 가면 보통 얼마나 걸려요?

sentences.en: It depends how busy it is, but if it's quiet, I can probably go in 20–30 minutes and it's done.
sentences.ko: 얼마나 붐비냐에 따라 다른데, 한가하면 20~30분이면 끝나요.

sentences.en: Wow.
What about you?
Well, I think my experience of the hairdresser is a little bit different.
sentences.ko: 음, 제 미용실 경험은 좀 달라요.

sentences.en: If I get a haircut and a hair dye – so, a hair dye is when you change the colour – it can take about three hours.
sentences.ko: 커트에 염색까지 하면, 염색은 머리색을 바꾸는 거죠, 3시간쯤 걸릴 수 있어요.

sentences.en: But I actually enjoy it.
I probably go to the hairdresser once every six months, and when I go, it's like a treat.
sentences.ko: 아마 6개월에 한 번쯤 미용실에 가는데, 갈 때마다 저한테 주는 선물 같아요.

sentences.en: OK. You told us about the hairdresser's, Georgie.
sentences.ko: 좋아요. 조지, 미용실 얘기를 해 줬는데요.

sentences.en: Do you often change your hairstyle?
Well, when I was at university, I once dyed my hair – not all of it, but half of it pink and green.
sentences.ko: 음, 대학 다닐 때 한번 머리를 염색했어요. 전부는 아니고, 반은 분홍색 반은 초록색으로요.

sentences.en: But the dye, the hair dye, wasn't permanent.
It was temporary, so the colour didn't stay, which was probably good for me.
sentences.ko: 일시적인 거라 색이 안 남았는데, 그게 저한텐 다행이었던 것 같아요.

sentences.en: I don't think I suited it.
But recently I actually have thought about growing my hair, so I want to grow it, make it a bit longer and I want to stop dyeing it as well.
sentences.ko: 그런데 최근엔 머리를 기를까 생각했어요. 좀 더 길게 기르고, 염색도 그만하고 싶어요.

sentences.en: So, in the last few years I have been dyeing my hair a bit blonder, but I was looking at some old photos of me when I had brown, natural hair, and I think I'd like to go back to it.
sentences.ko: 지난 몇 년간 머리를 좀 더 밝게 염색했는데, 자연 갈색 머리였던 옛날 사진을 보다가 다시 돌아가고 싶어졌어요.

sentences.en: Yeah. What about you?
I don't think I'm going to change my hair.
sentences.ko: 저는 머리를 바꿀 것 같진 않아요.

sentences.en: Do you think green would suit?
Phil, I think you would look great with green hair.
sentences.ko: 필, 초록 머리 정말 잘 어울릴 것 같아요.

sentences.en: Maybe. Maybe we should try that, because my hair is changing its colour itself.
sentences.ko: 그럴지도요. 해 봐야 할지도 몰라요, 제 머리가 알아서 색을 바꾸고 있거든요.

sentences.en: It's going greyer and greyer and greyer.
sentences.ko: 점점 더, 더, 더 하얘지고 있어요.

sentences.en: And every time I get my hair cut, more grey comes off.
sentences.ko: 머리 자를 때마다 흰머리가 더 많이 떨어져요.

sentences.en: Ah, well, maybe green would be...
...the way forward!
Yeah.
The other thing is there's less of it.
sentences.ko: 또 하나는 머리숱이 줄고 있다는 거예요.

sentences.en: When I get my hair cut, I can see it's higher up, and there's a bit going a little bit bald there, but hopefully no one notices.
sentences.ko: 머리 자를 때 보면 이마선이 올라갔고, 여기가 살짝 벗겨지고 있어요. 아무도 눈치 못 챘으면 좋겠어요.

sentences.en: Let's recap the language we heard during the conversation.
If you dye your hair, and that's spelt 'D-Y-E', then you use chemicals to change the colour.
sentences.ko: 머리를 dye한다면, 철자는 'D-Y-E'인데, 화학 약품으로 색을 바꾸는 거예요.

sentences.en: Blonde hair is a light colour, a bit like yellow.
sentences.ko: Blonde 머리는 밝은 색, 노란색 비슷한 색이에요.

sentences.en: Ginger hair is a bit like orange.
If your hair is curly or wavy, it's not straight.
sentences.ko: 머리가 curly나 wavy하면 곧지 않은 거예요.

sentences.en: It has curves.
And if you're bald, you don't have any hair on your head.
sentences.ko: 그리고 bald면 머리에 머리카락이 없는 거예요.

sentences.en: That's it for this episode of Real Easy English.
sentences.ko: Real Easy English 이번 에피소드는 여기까지예요.

sentences.en: We'll be back next week with another conversation in easy English.
sentences.ko: 다음 주에 쉬운 영어로 된 다른 대화로 돌아올게요.

sentences.en: And don't forget to test what you've learned with the free worksheet on our website.
sentences.ko: 그리고 웹사이트의 무료 학습지로 배운 걸 확인하는 것도 잊지 마세요.

sentences.en: Go to bbclearningenglish.com.
Bye for now.
Goodbye!
